text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-dono, since today is Valentine's 
Day, please take this.
choice_data_list: Huh!? You prepared this for me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Does it seem unexpected after all? 
Well, I am not particularly accustomed to 
Valentine's Day events myself, so that is 
only natural.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to conveying your feelings, 
choosing the right chocolate really is 
important after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So adding a present to the chocolate is 
another way to make it feel special, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Putting all your feelings into a special 
Valentine's chocolate that says "You're 
the only one for me!" It's a shojo manga 
classic!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ryaaan, got a second? ...Huh, what're you 
reading?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawa! I-I'm on my way!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...'Valentine's Day is an event where you 
convey your feelings to someone special.'

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Convey your feelings to that special 
someone with special chocolates!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, so that was the intention behind 
the chocolate. I see...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are very special, Trainer-dono. 
I felt I must take this opportunity to 
properly express my gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-It's special, but only strictly 
speaking! In the trainer sort of way, that 
is!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's not that I see our 
relationship as purely professional...! I 
truly look up to you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Uuu... ...Um, that is to say...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
T-To me, they deserve my special 
gratitude!!

Her words got tangled up, but Yaeno 
Muteki's feelings came through clearly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?! What a stroke of good 
fortune...
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I open it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Here you go!

Inside the present were chocolates and a 
photo book titled "Baby Animals."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I examined the chocolates carefully, but 
alas, I did not know your preferences, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So, I have also included the photo album 
that I carry with me every day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Gazing upon the weak and fragile allows 
me to return to the core essence of the 
Kongo Yaegaki style: the spirit of 
'protection.'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And your heart will find calm. I guarantee 
it will soothe you.

I see, so you also gifted me the photo 
album that Yaeno Muteki cherishes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, that is Volume 6. It is a 
newer edition than the one in my 
possession.
choice_data_list:
If you haven't read it yet, do you want to 
read it together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! I would be delighted to join you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hawa, hawawa... So cute... Pink paw 
pads... How utterly precious...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Please wait, Trainer-dono! Just a 
little longer... I wish to bask in the 
presence of this kitten...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We have plenty of time. Let us take it 
slow and savor every moment.

In a calm and warm atmosphere, looking 
through photos of adorable animals, I 
spent a blissful time with Yaeno Muteki.

Inside the present were chocolates and a 
small teddy bear plushie.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I examined the chocolates carefully, but 
alas, I did not know your preferences, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made a handmade gift and 
included it inside.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am well-accustomed to needlework 
from mending clothes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That bear is... crafted in the exact same 
design as the one in my room.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In my room, there is a lovely and precious 
teddy bear given to me by my grandparents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When thinking about what to give, I 
figured I should consider what made me 
happy to receive.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I made it to resemble that plushie.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Was it thoughtless of me to give you 
something that I personally would be happy 
to receive...?"
choice_data_list:
No, I'm thrilled! I'll cherish and take 
great care of it!
No, I'm so happy! I'll cherish it dearly!

text_block_list.text:
I gently stroke the small plushie. Its 
ears are slightly different sizes, and its 
handmade feel makes it utterly endearing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono, there is a piece of 
advice I wish to offer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That bear is truly akin to an alter ego of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Doting on them in my absence is perfectly 
fine by me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, right now, the one standing 
before you is me.
choice_data_list: So, Yaeno wants to be petted too...?
So, Yaeno wants to be petted too...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
N-No, what are you saying all of a 
sudden...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's not what I'm talking about...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Trying to do unfamiliar things like 
Valentine's has completely thrown off my 
rhythm...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I am acutely aware of my own 
inexperience! Ah, good grief...!"

Not only the chocolate and the gift, but 
seeing Yaeno Muteki's rare expression made 
this a memorable Valentine's Day!
